item.title: DJI Mini 4 Pro vs Autel EVO Lite+: Two Drones, Two Different Definitions of “Better”
item.description: Most drone comparisons start with specs. Here’s a better test. Imagine you are already on the trip. Which drone do you actually have with you? That is why this comparison matters.
